description: §42.2.2a / §63.5 — the soft-deprecated presence spelling `x is some` in a value position (`const present: bool = @user is some`), a compound condition (`@user is some && @n > 0`) and a parenthesized `if=` test. The deprecated form is in-contract during the window: it surfaces W-IS-SOME-DEPRECATED (Info) once per site (3 here) and runs identically to its canonical twin condition/is-given-expr-twin — clicking #go sets @user, so @label = "present" (@n is 0) and #who renders. The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §42.2.2a (S462) — `expr is some` SHALL parse and behave identically to `expr is given` in every position, and SHALL surface W-IS-SOME-DEPRECATED (Info, §34) at each site. §63.5 — during the window the W-code is a conformance-required code and the deprecated form's runtime is identical to the canonical form's. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, validator too, go".
